title: BTS ARIRANG World Tour Night 3 at Allegiant Stadium Las Vegas — Post-AMA Homecoming Show
detail: BTS performs Night 3 of their four-night sold-out ARIRANG World Tour residency at Allegiant Stadium in Las Vegas on May 27, 2026, the day after sweeping the 52nd American Music Awards. The show begins at 8 PM local time with BTS opening on the 360-degree in-the-round rotating stage performing 'Hooligan' — the same number they opened the AMAs with two nights prior — to a capacity crowd of 65,000. The ~2.5-hour, ~20-song set includes the full ARIRANG album performed in sequence, supplemented by fan-favorite catalog hits and rotating 'surprise songs' exclusive to the Las Vegas run (Night 3's surprise slots confirmed as 'Black Swan' and 'Spine Breaker'). The post-AMA atmosphere translates into exceptional crowd energy, with ARMY singing in unison during emotional ballads. Consequence.net, reviewing the Las Vegas run, describes BTS as 'returning to Las Vegas as masters of intimacy on a grand scale,' with the Las Vegas Review-Journal calling the residency 'the most consequential pop concert event in Las Vegas history since the Sphere opened.' Night 4 completes the Las Vegas engagement on May 28 before the ARIRANG World Tour's next international leg.
